name: wiring-trainer
description: 박승권의 결선 작업장 - PLC/HMI/인버터 결선 연습 데스크톱 앱

scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start:xgsim: npm run build:xgsim-host && npm run build:renderer && electron .
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run test:performance && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm run verify:release && npm run build:xgsim-host && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.build:installer: npm run verify:release && npm run build:xgsim-host && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.build:offline: npm run verify:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.offline.yml --win portable --x64
scripts.build:installer:offline: npm run verify:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.offline.yml --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:share: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/package-share-release.ps1

author: bark
